description: This file contains a test implementation of the IBlockPoolMonitor interface, used for testing and monitoring object pool memory tracking in Orleans streams. It defines a class for tracking call counts of memory allocation and release, along with a reporting method, and a serializable counters class with Orleans-specific attributes.

classes.name: BlockPoolMonitorForTesting
classes.description: A class implementing IBlockPoolMonitor for testing purposes, tracking method calls related to memory allocation and reporting.

classes.name: ObjectPoolMonitorCounters
classes.description: A serializable class holding counters for monitoring object pool activities, with Orleans serialization attributes.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Increments the counter for object allocations from cache.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Increments the counter for objects released from cache.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Increments the report call counter, typically called to record a report event.
